title.narrative: MMD III - Africa-EU Migration and Mobility Dialogue support programme

description.narrative: Contract related to: MMD III - Africa-EU Migration and Mobility Dialogue support programme - MMD III¿s overall objective will be to support the orderly, safe, regular and responsible migration and mobility of people within Africa, and between Africa and Europe. Its specific objectives will be: 1)     To improve governance and cooperation on migration and mobility within Africa and between Africa and the EU through dialogue and knowledge sharing; 2)     To improve the role of civil society organisations (CSOs) (including diaspora organisations) and local authorities (LAs) as actors for development in the field of migration at regional/multi-country/continental-levels.MMD III will comprise two main components, firstly an ¿institutional¿ component including the Secretariats of the Khartoum and Rabat Processes, and   C2CMMD). Secondly, in order to bolster links between the dialogues and the JVAP framework on one side, and civil society, and local authorities on the other, the 2nd component will provide support to initiatives (selected via a call for proposals) to carry out projects on migration. This will add an operational element to MMD III, helping to translate engagements and commitments into concrete action, which will strengthen the sustainability and impact of the dialogues. These projects will tackle some of the main migration and mobility challenges at regional/multi-country/continental level, harnessing the expertise and knowledge of CSOs and LAs.  In terms of beneficiaries, MMD III¿s actions will benefit governments and their agencies and institutions ¿ providing them access to a space where they can dialogue with other governments on migration and mobility as well as a forum for policy and knowledge exchange. It will also benefit civil society and LAs by providing them with financial support to carry out their activities. Due to the development of policies to facilitate regular safe and orderly migration, final beneficiaries will be the migrant population as well as migrants¿ families and communities. MMD III will contribute to equitable digital transformation as a driver of sustainable development, building on previous phases, which explored, in particular, digital technologies in the area of remittances, as well as mobilising diaspora investment. Building on lessons learnt and recommendations from MMDI & II, MMD III will continue to make use of virtual solutions to ensure cooperation and continued engagement with and among partners. It will continue to support the use of digital technology for the generation and collection of data on migration supporting.

title.narrative: 1.4.2 Number of initiatives published in the database

description.narrative: In the context of JVAP Followup, `Initiatives encompass both Projects and Policies enacted by JVAP Partners. `Projects refer to all JVAPfunded activities within the Rabat and Khartoum Process regions that align with JVAP Domains. `Policies, conversely, include legislations, reforms, regulations, decrees, strategies, and international agreements. The JVAP Database currently categorizes Programs, Projects, or Activities under the umbrella term `Projects. This lack of distinction has led to a varied scope of reported initiatives up until the 2022 Data Collection Cycle. However, as the 2024 Evaluations and Overhaul of JVAP Followup are underway at the time of this logframes finalization, a more nuanced categorization will be introduced. This will place a greater emphasis on, and preference for, actual `Projects over `Programs or `Activities.

description.narrative: To support the orderly, safe, regular, and responsible migration and mobility of people within Africa, and between Africa and Europe.

title.narrative: Summary of the extent of MMDs contributions to GERF 2.21 and SDG 10.7

description.narrative: Qualitative review of MMD contributions, specifically SDG Indicator 10.7.2 (Number of countries with migration policies to facilitate orderly, safe, regular and responsible migration and mobility of people) which aims to describe the state of national migration policies and how such policies change over time. It includes a total of 30 subcategories, under 6 questions/domains, based on IOMs Migration Governance Framework (MiGOF).
